blocked.message: missing credentials: pub.youtube.demo.client_id, pub.youtube.demo.client_secret, pub.youtube.demo.refresh_token (backend: env)
owner_action: 1. In https://console.cloud.google.com create (or pick) YOUR OWN project; it costs nothing and needs no card for this API.
2. APIs & Services > Library: enable 'YouTube Data API v3' and 'YouTube Analytics API'.
3. OAuth consent screen: External, add your Google account as a test user (or publish the app).
4. Credentials > Create credentials > OAuth client ID > Application type 'Desktop app'. Keep the client ID + secret private.
5. Run: python -m nexus.intelligence.publishing.youtube_oauth --label demo  (paste the client ID/secret when asked, sign in with the channel's account in the browser that opens).
6. Without Account 1's vault, set environment variables instead: NEXUS_PUB_YOUTUBE_DEMO_CLIENT_ID, NEXUS_PUB_YOUTUBE_DEMO_CLIENT_SECRET, NEXUS_PUB_YOUTUBE_DEMO_REFRESH_TOKEN.
7. Register the account: engine.connect_account('youtube', 'demo', secret_ref='pub.youtube.demo.refresh_token').
NEXUS uploads as PRIVATE unless you approve a manifest yourself (approval = 'approved_by_owner').

blocked.message: tiktok: publishing needs the owner's own developer app approved by the platform; NEXUS has not verified this flow against a live account
owner_action: Register an app at https://developers.tiktok.com, add the Content Posting API product.
Get the video.publish scope approved; the creator authorises the app via Login Kit.
Until TikTok audits the app, every post is private (SELF_ONLY).
Store the user access token in the vault under the account's secret_ref, then connect_account(..., app_approved=True).

blocked.message: instagram_reels: publishing needs the owner's own developer app approved by the platform; NEXUS has not verified this flow against a live account
owner_action: Use an Instagram professional (business/creator) account.
Create a Meta app with instagram_business_content_publish (Instagram Login) or instagram_content_publish + pages_read_engagement (Facebook Login); obtain Advanced Access through Meta app review.
Resumable uploads need Facebook Login for Business; otherwise the video must be at a public URL (video_url).
Store the access token in the vault, set the account's external_id to the IG user id, connect_account(..., app_approved=True).
